verses.original: שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּעֲל֗וֹת לְדָ֫וִ֥ד לוּלֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה שֶׁהָ֣יָה לָ֑נוּ יֹֽאמַר־ נָ֝א יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: šîr ham·ma·‘ă·lō·wṯ lə·ḏā·wiḏ lū·lê Yah·weh še·hā·yāh lā·nū yō·mar- nā yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: A song of ascents Of David If the LORD had not been on our side let Israel now declare
verses.literalPt: Se não fora Jeová que esteve ao nosso lado, diga, pois, Israel;

verses.original: לוּלֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה שֶׁהָ֣יָה לָ֑נוּ בְּק֖וּם עָלֵ֣ינוּ אָדָֽם׃
verses.literal: if the LORD had not been on our side when men attacked us
verses.literalPt: se não fora Jeová que esteve ao nosso lado, quando os homens se levantaram contra nós,

verses.original: אֲ֭זַי חַיִּ֣ים בְּלָע֑וּנוּ בַּחֲר֖וֹת אַפָּ֣ם בָּֽנוּ׃
verses.literal: when their anger flared against us then they would have swallowed us alive
verses.literalPt: então, nos teriam engolido vivos, quando a sua ira se acendeu contra nós;

verses.original: אֲ֭זַי הַמַּ֣יִם שְׁטָפ֑וּנוּ נַ֗֜חְלָה עָבַ֥ר עַל־ נַפְשֵֽׁנוּ׃
verses.literal: then the floods would have engulfed us then the torrent would have overwhelmed . . . us
verses.literalPt: então, nos teriam submergido as águas, sobre a nossa alma teria passado a torrente;

verses.original: אֲ֭זַי עָבַ֣ר עַל־ נַפְשֵׁ֑נוּ הַ֝מַּ֗יִם הַזֵּֽידוֹנִֽים׃
verses.literal: then the raging waters would have swept us away . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: então, sobre a nossa alma teriam passado as águas altivas.

verses.original: בָּר֥וּךְ יְהוָ֑ה שֶׁלֹּ֥א נְתָנָ֥נוּ טֶ֝֗רֶף לְשִׁנֵּיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bā·rūḵ Yah·weh šel·lō nə·ṯā·nā·nū ṭe·rep̄ lə·šin·nê·hem
verses.literal: Blessed be the LORD who has not given us as prey to their teeth
verses.literalPt: Bendito seja Jeová, que não nos entregou, como presa, aos dentes deles!

verses.original: נַפְשֵׁ֗נוּ כְּצִפּ֥וֹר נִמְלְטָה֮ מִפַּ֪ח י֫וֹקְשִׁ֥ים הַפַּ֥ח נִשְׁבָּ֗ר וַאֲנַ֥חְנוּ נִמְלָֽטְנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: nap̄·šê·nū kə·ṣip·pō·wr nim·lə·ṭāh mip·paḥ yō·wq·šîm hap·paḥ niš·bār wa·’ă·naḥ·nū nim·lā·ṭə·nū
verses.literal: We have escaped like a bird from the snare of the fowler the net is torn and we have slipped away
verses.literalPt: A nossa alma, como um pássaro, escapou do laço dos caçadores; quebrou-se o laço, e nós escapamos.

verses.original: עֶ֭זְרֵנוּ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.literal: Our help is in the name of the LORD the Maker of heaven and earth
verses.literalPt: O nosso auxílio está em o nome de Jeová, que fez o céu e a terra.
